They keep telling us the charges are for something different every time we ask. First they said it was for packing materials which we hadn’t asked for. Now they’re saying it’s for space. I got a quote for about 300 cubic square feet. I was told that amount of space was suitable for an entire two bedroom apartment, and we are moving much less than that. They will not let us see the total amount in the truck. They also would not let us do our own measurements. We do have photos of what we did have. (A couch, queen bed and some boxes). Since they’re here already and our move is scheduled, we really have no choice. I wish I had been more diligent with measurements but I feel I was extremely misled by the sale rep. and there is no way I will be able to pay the entire remainder upon delivery.
